SUBHADEEP BATABYAL

Bengaluru, India | +91-9614546503 | subhadeepbatabyal06@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/subhadeep-batabyal-b89ab787

NETWORK OPERATIONS ENGINEER | IP NETWORKING | TELECOM BACKBONE | OPTICAL &

TRANSMISSION OPS | INCIDENT MANAGEMENT

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Network Infrastructure and Operations Engineer with 8+ years of experience in large-scale IP networking, telecom transmission systems, network security operations, enterprise WAN environments, and critical incident management across global customer infrastructures. Strong expertise in TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer2/Layer3 routing, enterprise circuits, ISP backbone coordination, packet loss/latency diagnostics, VPN technologies, and systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Experienced in handling high-severity outages in 24x7 NOC environments, coordinating with telecom providers, engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure service restoration, uptime, and root cause elimination. Hands-on exposure to optical/backhaul transmission systems, EMS/NMS style monitoring workflows, and large-scale internet service operations.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS

Routing / Protocols: TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLAN, STP, ARP, ICMP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, Layer2/Layer3 Troubleshooting, SDWAN basics Telecom / Backbone: Enterprise Circuits, DWDM/Transmission Exposure, ISP Coordination, WAN Routing, Link Failover, Latency & Packet Loss Analysis, Optical Backhaul Validation Network Security: Zscaler ZIA/ZPA/ZDX, Ivanti Pulse Secure VPN, GRE/IPSec, SSL VPN, SAML, Okta, Duo MFA, Proxy, Certificates Wireless / Infra: Aruba Central, ArubaOS, WLAN Controllers, RF Diagnostics, 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax Packet / Log Analysis: Wireshark, tcpdump, MTR, iPerf, Fiddler, RCA, Incident Analysis, Traceroute Validation Cloud / Monitoring: AWS, Azure, Active Directory, NSS/LSS, EMS/NMS Monitoring Concepts, Public Cloud Connectivity Operations: P1/P2 Incident Handling, NOC Escalation, Shift Operations, SLA Management, Change Validation, Cross-functional Collaboration

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

ZSCALER — Senior Technical Support Engineer / Network Security Engineer | Apr 2025 – Present

Troubleshoot large-scale enterprise secure access and cloud edge network deployments across ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, Browser Isolation, NSS/LSS, and traffic forwarding platforms.

Perform packet-level diagnosis for TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ARP, SSL, GRE, and IPSec related failures impacting global enterprise users and branch connectivity.

Validate routing path issues, PAC forwarding logic, tunnel establishment, cloud log streaming, and proxy traffic steering using systematic troubleshooting workflows.

Coordinate with ISP teams, endpoint teams, customer network engineers, and cloud teams during P1/P2 incidents to restore critical services rapidly.

Conduct detailed RCA for latency, packet drops, authentication path failures, and internet reachability issues using Wireshark, MTR, iPerf, and telemetry tools.

IVANTI — Enterprise Technical Solutions Engineer (Pulse Secure VPN) | 2023 – 2025

Diagnosed and resolved complex Layer2/Layer3 enterprise VPN outages across Pulse Connect Secure deployments globally.

Performed systematic troubleshooting for routing anomalies, certificate trust issues, tunnel disruptions, clustering failures, and remote access outages.

Managed escalations from L1/L2 teams and collaborated with engineering for product defect isolation and service-impacting bug analysis.

Delivered detailed technical RCA and uptime restoration planning for customer production incidents.

MOVATE TECHNOLOGIES (HPE ARUBA) — Senior Network Support Engineer | 2021 – 2023

Provided P1/P2 escalation support for large enterprise Aruba wireless and IP infrastructures consisting of thousands of APs and controller-managed environments.

Troubleshot WLAN instability, roaming failures, RF interference, DHCP/VLAN issues, Layer2/Layer3 reachability failures, and controller datapath drops.

Performed packet capture and RF analysis to isolate AP tunnel failures, authentication delays, and traffic forwarding anomalies.

Supported post-change validation, network health monitoring, and customer-impacting outage coordination in 24x7 support operations.

ACCENTURE (Google Fi / Google Store Operations) — Technical Associate / Network Operations | 2019 – 2021

Performed L1/L2 troubleshooting of enterprise IP circuits and WAN services for Severity 2/3 outages including packet loss, latency spikes, ISP routing instability, and link failures.

Monitored customer WAN links, internet provider incidents, and transmission outages while coordinating with telecom carriers including AT&T;, Verizon, and Comcast.

Investigated traceroute asymmetry, route degradation, backbone interruptions, and business service outages using systematic operational methodologies.

Maintained uptime through provider escalations, incident prioritization, and cross-functional outage management.

HIGHTECH NEXT ENGINEERING & TELECOM (Reliance Jio Project) — Telecom Transmission Engineer | 2018 – 2019

Worked on 4G telecom transmission rollout, optical backhaul readiness, transmission connectivity implementation, and telecom node benchmarking.

Supported site validation, field transmission verification, KPI review, and corrective actions for newly commissioned telecom infrastructure.

Coordinated with field teams for network service degradation, handover failures, and transmission optimization activities.

CERTIFICATIONS

Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA Routing & Switching, Security) Palo Alto Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE) Aruba Central Practitioner / Aruba Cloud Essentials Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator (ZDTA) Cyber Security Certification – Great Lakes

EDUCATION

B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering | Techno India College of Technology | 2013 – 2017

ADDITIONAL HIGHLIGHTS

(cid:127) Comfortable working in 24x7 Network Operations Center / shift-based environments (cid:127) Strong exposure to large-scale IP networks, telecom backbone incidents, provider coordination, and cloud connectivity troubleshooting (cid:127) Excellent cross-functional communication with engineering, ISP, telecom, and customer infrastructure teams (cid:127) Immediate Joiner

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Network Infrastructure and Operations Engineer with 8+ years of experience in large-scale IP networking, telecom transmission systems, network security operations, enterprise WAN environments, and critical incident management across global customer infrastructures. Strong expertise in TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer2/Layer3 routing, enterprise circuits, ISP backbone coordination, packet loss/latency diagnostics, VPN technologies, and systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Experienced in handling high-severity outages in 24x7 NOC environments, coordinating with telecom providers, engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure service restoration, uptime, and root cause elimination. Hands-on exposure to optical/backhaul transmission systems, EMS/NMS style monitoring workflows, and large-scale internet service operations.
CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ZSCALER — Senior Technical Support Engineer / Network Security Engineer | Apr 2025 – Present
Troubleshoot large-scale enterprise secure access and cloud edge network deployments across ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, Browser Isolation, NSS/LSS, and traffic forwarding platforms.
Perform packet-level diagnosis for TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ARP, SSL, GRE, and IPSec related failures impacting global enterprise users and branch connectivity.
Validate routing path issues, PAC forwarding logic, tunnel establishment, cloud log streaming, and proxy traffic steering using systematic troubleshooting workflows.
Coordinate with ISP teams, endpoint teams, customer network engineers, and cloud teams during P1/P2 incidents to restore critical services rapidly.
Conduct detailed RCA for latency, packet drops, authentication path failures, and internet reachability issues using Wireshark, MTR, iPerf, and telemetry tools.
IVANTI — Enterprise Technical Solutions Engineer (Pulse Secure VPN) | 2023 – 2025
Diagnosed and resolved complex Layer2/Layer3 enterprise VPN outages across Pulse Connect Secure deployments globally.
Performed systematic troubleshooting for routing anomalies, certificate trust issues, tunnel disruptions, clustering failures, and remote access outages.
Managed escalations from L1/L2 teams and collaborated with engineering for product defect isolation and service-impacting bug analysis.
Delivered detailed technical RCA and uptime restoration planning for customer production incidents.
MOVATE TECHNOLOGIES (HPE ARUBA) — Senior Network Support Engineer | 2021 – 2023
Provided P1/P2 escalation support for large enterprise Aruba wireless and IP infrastructures consisting of thousands of APs and controller-managed environments.
Troubleshot WLAN instability, roaming failures, RF interference, DHCP/VLAN issues, Layer2/Layer3 reachability failures, and controller datapath drops.
Performed packet capture and RF analysis to isolate AP tunnel failures, authentication delays, and traffic forwarding anomalies.
Supported post-change validation, network health monitoring, and customer-impacting outage coordination in 24x7 support operations.
ACCENTURE (Google Fi / Google Store Operations) — Technical Associate / Network Operations | 2019 – 2021
Performed L1/L2 troubleshooting of enterprise IP circuits and WAN services for Severity 2/3 outages including packet loss, latency spikes, ISP routing instability, and link failures.
Monitored customer WAN links, internet provider incidents, and transmission outages while coordinating with telecom carriers including AT&T;, Verizon, and Comcast.
Investigated traceroute asymmetry, route degradation, backbone interruptions, and business service outages using systematic operational methodologies.
Maintained uptime through provider escalations, incident prioritization, and cross-functional outage management.
HIGHTECH NEXT ENGINEERING & TELECOM (Reliance Jio Project) — Telecom Transmission Engineer | 2018 – 2019
Worked on 4G telecom transmission rollout, optical backhaul readiness, transmission connectivity implementation, and telecom node benchmarking.
Supported site validation, field transmission verification, KPI review, and corrective actions for newly commissioned telecom infrastructure.
Coordinated with field teams for network service degradation, handover failures, and transmission optimization activities.
